app.title: ExamPanel
app.subtitle: School-Year Exam Paper Assignment & Review Automation

common.placeholderNotice: Module is currently in skeleton structure (Phase 1). Business logic will be implemented in upcoming phases.

overview.title: Dashboard Overview
overview.description: Manage and track exam assignment and review panels across the entire academic year.
overview.coreDescription: Verifying IPC communication between UI and the Rust core engine.
overview.scaleInfo: 11 teachers, 4 campuses, 4 exams (GK1, CK1, GK2, CK2) × 3 grades (10, 11, 12) = 12 panels, 36 assignments (24 setters, 12 reviewers).

teachers.title: Teacher Management
teachers.description: Manage teacher roster, campuses, grades taught, load weights, and active status.

exams.title: Exams & Grades
exams.description: Configure 4 standard exam terms (GK1, CK1, GK2, CK2) and grade levels (10, 11, 12).

rules.title: Rules & Constraints
rules.description: Configure 7 hard constraints (H1-H7), 7 soft constraints (S1-S7), and PIN / FORBID locks.

assignments.title: Assignment Plans
assignments.description: Execute randomized backtracking and simulated annealing to generate optimal assignment plans.

stats.title: Statistics & Reports
stats.description: Analyze workload distribution, setter/reviewer balance, campus diversity, and export reports.

settings.title: System Settings
settings.description: Configure portable SQLite database path, solver parameters, and UI preferences.

diagnostics.insufficient_setters: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: only {{count}} teachers eligible as setter (minimum 2 required)
diagnostics.insufficient_reviewers: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: only {{count}} teachers eligible as reviewer (minimum 1 required)
diagnostics.insufficient_campuses: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: available teachers belong to only {{count}} campus (minimum 2 campuses required)
diagnostics.lock_conflict: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: conflicting PIN and FORBID locks for the same teacher
diagnostics.excess_pinned_setters: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: {{count}} teachers pinned as setter (maximum 2 allowed)
diagnostics.excess_pinned_reviewers: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: {{count}} teachers pinned as reviewer (maximum 1 allowed)
diagnostics.excess_pins_in_panel: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: {{count}} pinned assignments in panel (maximum 3 allowed)
diagnostics.pinned_teacher_ineligible: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: pinned teacher is ineligible (does not teach grade, unavailable, or inactive)
diagnostics.pinned_teacher_multiple_panels: {{exam}}: teacher is pinned to {{count}} panels in the same exam period (violates rule H4)
diagnostics.pinned_campus_monopoly: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: all 3 pinned teachers belong to the same campus (violates campus diversity H3)
diagnostics.pinned_quota_exceeded: Teacher has {{count}} pinned assignments, exceeding maximum quota ({{hi}})
diagnostics.insufficient_total_capacity: Total maximum capacity across all teachers ({{max_capacity}}) is less than required slots ({{total_slots}})
diagnostics.excess_minimum_capacity: Total minimum capacity across all teachers ({{min_capacity}}) exceeds required slots ({{total_slots}})
diagnostics.exam_capacity_infeasible: {{exam}}: maximum achievable assignment flow is {{max_flow}} / {{required}} under single-panel-per-exam rule
diagnostics.panel_unfillable_under_h4: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: panel cannot be filled under single-panel-per-exam rule (achieved {{flow}} / {{required}})
diagnostics.tight_panel_roster: {{exam}} – Grade {{grade}}: roster has exactly {{count}} eligible teachers (no substitution margin)
diagnostics.teacher_single_panel_eligibility: Teacher {{teacher_name}} is eligible for only {{count}} panel across the academic year
diagnostics.restricted_reviewer_pool: Number of reviewer-eligible teachers ({{reviewer_count}}) is less than total teachers ({{teacher_count}})
